GENERAL_-_00_Prompt_Guardrails.inputs:
@if(equals(outputs('GENERAL_-_00_Rule_Classification'), 'Consolidation'), '', 'CLASSIFICATION RULES (these override anything below):
Consolidation = the customer explicitly asks to combine two or more POs or orders on the same truck or load (consolidate, ship together, ship with, ride with, same truck); needs at least two PO or SO numbers.
Cancellation = the customer explicitly asks to cancel a whole PO or order.
Wakefern Appointments = the customer schedules, reschedules or confirms a delivery appointment (appointment number, dock date or dock time). The word Wakefern or a Wakefern PO number is NOT enough.
No Match = everything else, and it is the default.
Never infer intent. Mentioning dates, POs, trucks or cases is not enough.
Always No Match: ship, delivery, NSOS, RDD or ETA date or status questions; CUT vs PUSH-OUT determinations; asking to push out or move a date; asking to remove, reduce, adjust or change a line, a quantity or a number of cases (order adjustment, not cancellation); price or availability questions; acknowledgements.

')
